newsitem.title: USA: Shop at Home Q2 revenues up 70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shop at Home Q2 revenues up 70 pct.

text.p: Shop At Home Inc said on Tuesday revenues for its second fiscal quarter ended December 31 rose by 70 percent to $16.1 million.

The company said it expected net income to improve substantially over the net loss of $942,842 in the same quarter last year and the net income of $166,000 in the most recent quarter ended September 30.

Final earnings results would be released by the end of January, it said. On a calendar year basis, Shop at Home said it generated $53.4 million in revenue, a 70 percent increase over the previous calendar year.
Kent Lillie, Shop At Home president, said the company expected to meet its original earnings goals for the six months period and was well on its way to accomplishing its annual projections.
